archiveAcquisition: Public official file fetched by HTTP byte ranges: ZIP central directory plus selected member ranges. Each selected .dat and .hea matches its original ZIP entry CRC32. The entire 1.277 GB archive was not downloaded, so its full-file MD5 is not claimed as verified.

records.integrityNote: ZIP entry CRC32 verified for raw data and header. Source WFDB initial-value and checksum fields contain channel maxima/minima rather than valid WFDB initial values/checksums; that source-header defect is preserved in provenance and not used for calibration.
records.processing: Little-endian WFDB format16, gain1000 digital units/mV and baseline0. All original samples retained. No additional signal processing.
records.territoryInterpretation: ECG teaching interpretation, supported by the lead distribution and source culprit-vessel label; not a separately provided source territory diagnosis.
